[09:32:30 AM] 
 
Good morning. The meeting of the Council Health and Human Services Committee is convened on June 
17, 2016, at 9:33 a.m. Members present are Council member Delia Garza, Chair Ora Houston, Kathie 
Tovo Vice Chair and Council member, Ellen Troxclair is not present at this moment. The purpose of this 
meeting deliberate the appointment of a member to the Central Health Board of Managers due to the 
resignation of a current members, Ms. Lynn Hudson. The committee will go into Executive Session to 
interview candidates and subsequently convene again to make a recommendation. At this time the 
Committee will go into Executive Session to interview candidates. 
 
After the interviews, the committee will reconvene to discuss and take action regarding a candidate for 
the Central Health Board of Managers. 
 
[9:34:45 PM] 
 
 
[12:47:18 PM] 
 
>> Houston: We're out of closed session. And in closed session we interviewed several excellent 
candidates for the position of the board of manager of central health. Really incredible people offering 
to provide a public service to the community that we all serve and love. And it's such a great opportunity 
for us to have these conversations with the individuals who offer themselves. I would like to see if we 
have a motion to nominate Dr. Charles bell to the board of central managers. >> I'll make that motion. 
>> Houston: Councilmember troxclair makes the motion. >> Tovo: I will second that and just add to the 
chair's comments, we really had an excellent, an excellent group of candidates and I really look forward 
to seeing all of them serve in some capacity within our city and community. Many are serving in many 
capacity, but if we have many other ones to consider, then I hope they will do so. >> Troxclair: And I'll 
echo the thoughts of mayor pro tem tovo. We had a really difficult decision as we always do, but it's 
encouraging to know how many people in Austin are so well qualified and care about our community so 
deeply that they're willing to not just dedicate they're time to be here today and to explore the 
opportunity, but also willing to contribute significant volunteer hours if they're chosen. So thank you to 
everybody who came. >> Houston: And they were also very passionate about access to health care for 
vulnerable populations. Everybody was on point on how important the role of central health was in the 
delivery of health care services to those who are vulnerable. So we're ready for the question? All in 
favor, let it be known by saying aye?  
 
[12:49:19 PM] 
 
>> Aye. >> Houston: It's unanimous on the dais. By way of notice, councilmember Garza had to leave so 
she is off the dais, but it is unanimous. And that will be our recommendation to the council on next 
Thursday, June the 23rd. This meeting is now recessed -- adjourned, 12:49
